command.neroevents.gallery.built_events: Gallery built north of you: %s exhibits and %s event stations (%s need a sibling mod: %s). The demo HUD and console are on for you — nothing shown is real. Run /neroevents gallery clear here to take it down.
command.neroevents.gallery.stress_built: Stress scene: %s meteors, %s pods and an ion storm preview. Look north from here, wait ten seconds, then run /nsevrender.
command.neroevents.gallery.protected: The gallery footprint is protected here (%s). Move elsewhere or use a test world; nothing was built.
command.neroevents.gallery.storm_live: A real storm is running in this dimension, so the storm preview stays off.
command.neroevents.gallery.cue_unknown: Unknown cue %s. Try supply_drop, meteor_shower, debris_crash, faction_war, hud_info, hud_reward, hud_hazard, hud_combat, hud_war or console.
command.neroevents.gallery.cue_no_consol: Stand within 6 blocks of one of the gallery's Event Consoles first.
command.neroevents.gallery.no_session: No live gallery session of yours here. Run /neroevents gallery first.
command.neroevents.gallery.demo_yields: A real event is live, so the gallery demo HUD and console step aside until it ends.
console.neroevents.gallery.demo: Gallery demo — nothing on this screen is real.
console.neroevents.gallery.demo_locked: Gallery demo: these buttons do nothing. Clear the gallery to use the console.
